subject: Municipal Building Solarization and Traffic Safety Initiatives
overview: The Council approved a resolution to equip municipal and school buildings with solar panels and requested a community liaison for the Green Line Extension project. Members also addressed various traffic safety concerns, including speeding and heavy trucking in residential neighborhoods, and requested a timeline for the upcoming budget process.

items.title: Infrastructure and Landscape Maintenance
items.summary: Approved several requests for repairs including tree root remediation at curbsides, pothole filling on Hutchins and Rita Roads, and grass cutting at various intersections including Fountain and Webster Streets.

items.title: Municipal Solar Energy Initiative
items.summary: Approved a resolution to equip municipal and school buildings with solar energy systems and requested a feasibility update from the Energy and Environment Office regarding potential cost savings.

items.title: Green Line Extension Community Liaison
items.summary: Approved a request for MassDOT and the MBTA to assign a community liaison to coordinate construction management and share information with residents and Tufts University.

items.title: Fulton Street Traffic Safety
items.summary: Requested directed police patrols and an update on the status of speed monitoring signs and radar equipment to address persistent speeding concerns near Gillis Park.

items.title: South and Harvard Street Trucking Concerns
items.summary: Referred concerns regarding speeding and heavy trucking to the Traffic Commission to evaluate trucking bans, raised crosswalks, and the creation of a specialized police trucking enforcement team.

items.title: Ceremonial Resolutions and Announcements
items.summary: Conducted routine business including a 75th birthday recognition, condolences for Grace Colonna, and announcements regarding a senior vegetable registration program and Memorial Day events.

items.title: Citywide Yard Sale Petition
items.summary: Placed on file a presentation regarding the June 10 Medford Citywide Yard Sale, a fundraiser benefiting the Friends of Felsmere Heights to oppose overdevelopment at the Malden Hospital site.

items.title: Budget Timeline and Department Planning
items.summary: Requested a timeline from the administration for budget hearings and scheduled a future meeting with the DPW Director to discuss citywide road and manhole cover repairs.
